## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and all tests pass
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated for every feature, setting or script changed
- [ ] Changes to existing code explained (see [engineering.md section 3](../docs/engineering.md#3-change-only-what-the-task-needs))
- [ ] No new dependency without a decision record in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] `PERF:` comments include What, Why, and Trade-off
